_readme: THE config file for the Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali agent — posts one verse per day at 12:00 EAT (owner rule 2026-10-07) to BOTH the Facebook page (binary photo upload) and the Instagram account (@biblia_tafsiri_mbalimbali, via hidden-FB-photo CDN container), alternating daily: English image+caption one day, Kiswahili image+caption the next (data/posts.json lang tags). (1) TOKENS: the permanent page token below (pageAccessToken) never expires — it was minted 2026-09-22 from the user token the owner pasted, using the app-id/secret exchange, and covers pages_manage_posts + instagram_content_publish. If it is ever revoked (password change / app removal), paste a fresh Graph API Explorer token into data/meta-token.txt and push — the next landed run re-mints it automatically. (2) Pause everything: set autoPost to false (the runner reads it live; force runs still work). (3) Schedule: slots + timezone — to change posting time edit 'slots' only; graceMinutes = IG catch-up window after slot time (420 = 12:00-19:00 EAT, 7 hours; owner rule 2026-10-07). (4) Mutual rescue: 'siblings' lists the pages this agent watches (Ladies of Destiny + Teacher's Lesson Plan) — any landed run here dispatches a sibling whose IG half is due but has no landed run of its own (token: dispatchToken in this file — owner's PERMANENT PAT since 2026-10-07, never remove its repo scopes (the 10-05 scope loss silently killed the rescue net and caused missed posts on 10-01 and 10-07)). Page: Biblia Tafsiri Mbalimbali = 447560908444853; IG = 17841470180666328. If this repo ever goes public, move these values to host env vars instead.
